title: The 48 Laws of Power
author: Robert Greene
description: Robert Greene examines strategies of influence and power through historical anecdotes and sharply stated maxims. The book offers a provocative lens on ambition, reputation and social manoeuvring, inviting readers to assess both the tactics and their ethical costs.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
